title: SAP FI AR - Manager
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Consulting - SAP – FI - AR Manager:**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced SAP Manager - FI Accounts Receivable (AR) to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of global receivables processes within SAP S/4HANA environments. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Order-to-Cash (OTC) and Accounts Receivable processes, with hands-on experience in banking integrations, collections, dispute management, and receivables transformation initiatives.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead SAP FI-AR solution design, implementation, and support across global business units.
* Manage and optimize AR processes including customer invoicing, cash application, collections, dispute resolution, dunning, and account reconciliation.
* Drive and support:

+ Bank Communication Management (BCM) Integration
+ Interest Calculation Configuration and Processing
+ AR Correspondence Management
+ Customer Account Statements
+ Lockbox Processing and Cash Application
+ HighRadius Integration for Collections and Dispute Management

* Collaborate with finance, treasury, banking, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable and compliant solutions.
* Lead transformation initiatives, process automation, and continuous improvement programs.
* Manage project delivery, stakeholder engagement, and cross-functional teams.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field.
* 10+ years of SAP Finance experience with strong expertise in SAP FI-AR.
* Proven experience with SAP BCM, Lockbox, Interest Calculation, Account Statements, and Correspondence Framework.
* Experience integrating SAP with HighRadius Collections and Dispute Management solutions.
* Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, OTC processes, and finance transformation programs.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Senior Process Associate - Accounts Payable
description:
**Position Summary**
The Accounts Payable Senior Process Associate is responsible for managing and executing the daily accounts payable operations, ensuring timely and accurate processing of vendor invoices, payments, and reconciliations. This role also involves supporting process improvements, maintaining data accuracy, and assisting in month-end closing activities. The ideal candidate will have strong attention to detail, solid understanding of AP procedures, and the ability to work effectively within a team.

* Manage Invoice Verification, Processing, Reporting on a Regular Basis.
* Resolve Invoice Discrepancies by coordinating with purchase team and suppliers.
* Prepare and submit weekly/monthly reports and assist in month end closing

* Email Management & Stake holder Management (Internal/External)

company: S P V S & Co., Chartered Accountants, Coimbatore
description:
**Company Description**
S P V S & Co., Chartered Accountants, is a professional services firm based in the Greater Coimbatore Area, providing assurance, taxation, and advisory services to a diverse portfolio of clients. The firm focuses on delivering accurate, compliant, and timely financial and tax solutions that support informed business decisions. Team members work in a collaborative environment that values technical excellence, integrity, and client-centric service. The firm offers opportunities to handle complex assignments, gain exposure to various industries, and grow through continuous learning and professional development.

**Role Description**
The Indirect Tax Associate will handle GST compliance for clients of S P V S & Co., Chartered Accountants across different industries. Day-to-day work includes preparing and filing monthly GST returns, reconciling input tax credit with GSTR-2B, and preparing annual returns in GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C. The associate will also draft replies to GST notices, prepare GST appeals and assist clients during departmental audits. All work is done under the review of a Chartered Accountant. The role also involves tracking changes in GST law and keeping client records and filing trackers up to date. This is a full-time, on-site role in Coimbatore. It requires regular interaction with clients, the internal team and GST officers

**Qualifications**

* CA Inter, or a graduate in commerce (B.Com, BBA or a related discipline) with experience in an auditor’s office.
* Exposure to GST return filing, annual returns or replies to GST notices.
* Working knowledge of the GST portal and basic GST concepts.
* Good Excel skills, including lookups, filters and pivot tables.
* Exposure to Tally and ERP packages.
* Good written and spoken communication in English and Tamil.
* Attention to detail and the ability to meet due dates across several clients.
* Willingness to learn and adapt.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and interpretation skills for complex tax issues.
* Ability to communicate clearly with clients and team members and to present technical information effectively.
* Attention to detail, high ethical standards, and the ability to manage multiple engagements and deadlines.

title: Independent Director
description:
**The Chair must understand what happens between the gate and the accounts**

This is a process-manufacturing mandate in which yield, grade, energy, water, effluent, maintenance, working capital and export execution all have financial consequences. The Board seeks a director capable of walking a plant, questioning the control design at source and later recognising the same issue in margin, provisions, cash flow and risk disclosure.

The dual chairship matters. Audit can identify recurring inventory, quality, safety or compliance issues; NRC must then ask whether accountabilities, capability, incentives and succession are helping or preventing durable correction. The director should resist the habit of treating people questions as separate from control quality.

**A plant-to-board agenda**

The first operating review should begin with material flow. The Chair will test purchase specifications, receipt controls, consumption norms, yield variance, rework, scrap, by-product accounting and finished-goods valuation. Variances should be understood by cause and recurrence, not merely absorbed into standard cost. Slow-moving and customer-specific inventory needs evidence-based provisioning.

The second lens is resource and process integrity. Water withdrawal, effluent treatment, emissions, chemical handling, energy intensity and waste are not solely ESG disclosures; they affect licence to operate, capital needs, contingent liability and customer acceptance. The committee should receive exceptions, near misses, consent conditions, monitoring reliability and closure evidence in a form that permits independent challenge.

Export and customer economics form the third lens. Foreign-exchange exposure, quality claims, shipment cut-off, rebates, customer concentration, logistics disruption and receivable recoverability should be reconciled to contract terms and cash. The Board needs to know when commercial accommodation becomes an accounting estimate or a conduct concern.

Maintenance and capex are the fourth. Deferred maintenance can flatter cash while increasing downtime, safety and quality risk. Each material capital project should have a baseline covering output, yield, resource intensity, safety and return; post-completion reviews should separate installation from realised benefit.

**NRC work that follows the evidence**

The appointee will lead succession planning for plant, commercial, finance and control leadership; review whether site-level managers can escalate bad news without penalty; and examine reward measures that may encourage volume at the expense of quality, resource compliance or working capital. A skills and dependency review should identify roles for which retirement, attrition or local knowledge loss would interrupt safe operation.

**The candidate**

Applicants may be manufacturing CFOs, plant or business heads, audit professionals, risk leaders or former chief executives with direct process-industry responsibility. They must show personal engagement with plant economics and control—not only corporate reporting. Experience of environmental compliance, export operations, labour-intensive sites or turnaround assurance is valuable. Previous Audit Committee chairship is preferred for the dual-chair role.

The appointment is conditional on independence checks, DIN and Independent Directors' Databank requirements. The Chair should expect site visits in addition to regular Board and committee meetings, with extra engagement around annual accounts, a material incident or leadership transition.

title: US Tax Analyst- Business
description:
The US Tax Analyst will be responsible for reviewing, analyzing, and ensuring the accuracy of US tax returns prepared by associates. The role involves applying in\-depth knowledge of US federal and state tax laws, ensuring compliance with IRS regulations, and providing feedback to preparers to maintain high\-quality deliverables. This position requires strong technical expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to guide junior team members.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Review US Individual, Partnership, Corporate, and Trust tax returns for accuracy and compliance with IRS and state regulations.
* Ensure that all returns are prepared in accordance with the latest US tax laws and filing requirements.
* Identify discrepancies, errors, or missing information and provide clear review notes for correction.
* Perform tax research and resolve complex tax issues as required.
* Monitor E\-filing processes and ensure timely submission of returns.
* Maintain updated knowledge of US tax laws, IRS guidelines, and changes in compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with tax preparers and provide guidance to improve accuracy and efficiency in tax return preparation.
* Assist in tax planning strategies and advisory tasks, when required.
* Ensure confidentiality and compliance with company policies regarding client data and documents.
* Support the training and development of junior associates in US tax concepts and return preparation.



  





  





**Required Skills \& Competencies:** 



* **Education \& Certification:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field. CPA/EA certification (added advantage).
* **Experience:** 
 3–5 years of experience in US tax preparation and review. Experience with multiple tax software platforms is an advantage.
* **Technical Knowledge:** 
 Strong understanding of US federal and state tax regulations, tax forms (1040, 1065, 1120, 1120S, 1041, etc.), and filing procedures.
* **Analytical Skills:** 
 Ability to analyze tax data, identify discrepancies, and provide accurate solutions.
* **Communication Skills:** 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills for effective review notes and client communication.
* **Technology Proficiency:** 
 Hands\-on experience with tax software (Drake, ProSystem, UltraTax, Lacerte, etc.) and MS Office.
* **Leadership:** 
 Ability to guide and mentor team members, ensuring quality and timely delivery.
* **Attention to Detail:** 
 Strong focus on accuracy, compliance, and deadlines.
* **Problem\-Solving:** 
 Aptitude for handling complex tax scenarios and providing practical solutions.

 We are looking for a Staff member to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.

The team members also receive on\-the\-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
   

  

 Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a Staff member within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.

In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe.
